summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned homepage 'Our Work' cards (.hb-related_work). Checked at 1920, 1440, 1280, 820 and 390 px. All 4 cards [data-testid=work-item-0..3] show the number (01-04, 34px, weight 300, rgb(43,43,43)) on the same row as a 1px #d9d9d9 rule (::before, grid col 2, align-items:center). The ' — ' separator is display:none. Under the number each card shows the uppercase category, the light title (2 lines for cards 1, 2 and 4; card 3 has one sentence, so it is 1 line on desktop and wraps to 2 at 820 and 390), the description, and the 'Explore <Category>' link with an arrow. The number, category, title, text and link share the same left x at every width. The grid is 2 columns at 820 and above and 1 column at 390. scrollWidth equals clientWidth at every width, so there is no horizontal scroll. Each of the 4 Explore links goes to the right page (/our-work/rakhigarhi, /theatre, /craft-livelihood, /workshops-learning) and lands at scrollY 0. In the live editor (/?edit=1, admin login) the category (items.N.title), title (items.N.subtitle) and description (items.N.text) can be selected and edited, and the editor panel shows text controls. I typed a test edit and did not save it; reloading showed no change was saved. /about, the 4 child pages and /connect have no .work-card elements, so they are not affected. /our-work redirects to /.

issues: The category, title and description have a saved inline style 'color: rgb(0,0,0) !important' (from items.N styles in content). This overrides the #2b2b2b in home-work.css, so these texts render pure black while the number and link are #2b2b2b. The difference is very small; clear those saved colors if exact #2b2b2b is wanted.
At 1440 and 1920 the section heading 'Shaped by Place...' is indented to the right of the card column's left edge (this predates the change, not a regression).

action_items: Optional: remove the saved #000 color overrides on items.N title/subtitle/text if all card text should be #2b2b2b.
critical_code_review_comments: The ' — ' separator .wn-sep is still in the DOM, hidden with display:none. That is fine for screen readers because the number is aria-hidden.
home-work.css uses very high-specificity selectors with !important. These still lose to inline !important styles saved by the editor (see the design issue).
seed_data_creation: None. The live-editor test edit was not saved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Card testids: work-item-N, -number, -category, -title, -description, -explore, -explore-label. The rule is .work-num::before. Login testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit. Live editor: live-save-btn, live-exit-btn, live-undo.
